paper_metadata.title: OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce OLMoE, a fully open, state-of-the-art language model leveraging sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). OLMoE-1B-7B has 7 billion (B) parameters but uses only 1B per input token. We pretrain it on 5 trillion tokens and further adapt it to create OLMoE-1B-7B-Instruct. Our models outperform all available models with similar active parameters, even surpassing larger ones like Llama2-13B-Chat and DeepSeekMoE-16B. We present various experiments on MoE training, analyze routing in our model showing high specialization, and open-source all aspects of our work: model weights, training data, code, and logs.

extraction_data.innovation: Sparse upcycling: cloning a dense MLP for each desired expert to form MoE layers, adding a newly initialized router, and continuing pretraining so cloned MLPs specialize and the router learns; Token Choice (TC) routing with a dropless MoE and load balancing loss to ensure equal expert distribution and improve training efficiency over Expert Choice (EC).
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: DCLM-Baseline, StarCoder, peS2o, arXiv, OpenWebMath, AlgebraicStack, English Wikipedia & Wikibooks
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Instruction tuning, Instruction tuning and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO)
extraction_data.extension: Sparse upcycling turns a dense model into a Mixture-of-Experts model by cloning the dense MLP for each expert and adding a newly initialized router, allowing the cloned MLPs to specialize while the router is learned.
extraction_data.research_problem: Cost-performance trade-off in language models and lack of open-source Mixture-of-Experts resources.
extraction_data.application: Language modeling, downstream evaluation (MMLU, HellaSwag, C4)
extraction_data.finetuning_data: tulu-v3.1-mix-preview-4096-OLMoE, ultrafeedback binarized cleaned, Tulu2 SFT Mix, NoRobots, CodeFeedback-Filtered-Instruction, MetaMathQA, Advanced subset of DaringAnteater, UltraFeedback, OpenHermes 2.5, Orca, HelpSteer2, OpenInstruct
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Multi-head self-attention with MoE feed-forward layers, Full attention
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretraining on 5 trillion tokens -> Adaptation to create INSTRUCT version
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: UltraFeedback binarized and filtered for TruthfulQA contamination
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: QK-Norm (query-key layer normalization); AdamW epsilon set to 1E-08 for improved stability and performance

extraction_data.moe_configuration: 7B total parameters per model; 1B, 2B, 4B, or 8B activated parameters depending on variant; 128 experts per layer, top-2 routing
